clauses.requirement: Criteria governing acceptability (Annex 4 para 2.5, within the minimum requirements for conformity verification by the manufacturer): the manufacturer shall carry out a statistical study of the test results and define, in agreement with the competent authority, acceptability criteria for its products to meet the conformity of production requirements of paragraph 6.1; the criteria shall be such that, with a confidence level of 95 per cent, the minimum probability of passing a spot check in accordance with Annex 5 is 0.95.
Annex 5: the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set out in this Annex shall be applied for verification of conformity of production of the lamp.
Annex 5 para 1: the general provisions for sampling by an inspector set out in this Annex shall be applied to the lamp.

Conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

Photometric conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances per paragraph 4.8 on any lamp chosen at random, no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3; for a lamp with a replaceable light source, if the results do not meet the requirements, the tests shall be repeated using another standard light source.
Where required according to paragraphs 4.1 and 4.2 of Annex 5, type approval shall be withdrawn according to paragraph 3.6 of this Regulation.

Annex 6: the heat resistance test for rear fog lamps and daytime running lamps shall be carried out as specified in this Annex; it applies to the lamp only if it incorporates such functions (rear fog lamp or daytime running lamp not listed for this product).

Heat resistance test (applicable to rear fog lamp and daytime running lamp functions, if present): the lamp shall be subjected to one hour of continuous operation following a 20-minute warm-up period, at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C; the light source shall be of the category specified for the lamp and supplied with a current at a voltage giving the specified average power at the corresponding test voltage; for lamps with non-replaceable light sources (filament and other), the test shall be made with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with paragraph 5.4.5 of this Regulation.
